cohort: 276 term singleton pregnancies with malpresentation out of 17,997 deliveries at a single hospital in India
finding: The perinatal mortality rate among term singleton malpresentations was 11.9%, and vaginal deliveries had a higher risk of low APGAR scores.
mod_finding: Vaginal deliveries in term breech malpresentations have a higher risk of low APGAR scores, with brow and shoulder presentations having the highest rates.
